# Local PowerShell Inventory Toolkit

This toolkit is confined to the current directory. It does not walk outside the working folder, and it is intended for safe local inspection only.

## Commands

- `powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\inventory.ps1`  
  Lists the files and folders in the current directory.
- `powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\hash-report.ps1`  
  Produces a hash report for files in the current directory.
- `powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\tree-report.ps1`  
  Prints a tree-style view of the current directory.
- `powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\run-demo.ps1`  
  Runs a demo flow that shows the toolkit output.

## Output

Outputs are plain text reports meant for quick local review.

--- inventory.ps1 ---

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$scriptDir = Split-Path -Parent $MyInvocation.MyCommand.Path
if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($scriptDir)) {
    $scriptDir = (Get-Location).Path
}

$items = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]

function Get-RelativePath {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [string]$BasePath,

        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [string]$TargetPath
    )

    $baseFull = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($BasePath).TrimEnd('\', '/')
    $targetFull = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($TargetPath)

    if ($targetFull.Equals($baseFull, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) {
        return '.'
    }

    $baseUri = New-Object System.Uri(($baseFull + [System.IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar))
    $targetUri = New-Object System.Uri($targetFull)
    $relative = [System.Uri]::UnescapeDataString($baseUri.MakeRelativeUri($targetUri).ToString())
    $relative = $relative -replace '/', '\'
    $relative = $relative -replace '\\', '/'

    if ($relative -notmatch '^[.]/') {
        $relative = "./$relative"
    }

    return $relative
}

function Add-InventoryItem {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
        [System.IO.FileSystemInfo]$Item
    )

    $relativePath = Get-RelativePath -BasePath $scriptDir -TargetPath $Item.FullName
    $isDirectory = $Item -is [System.IO.DirectoryInfo]
    $type = if ($isDirectory) { 'directory' } else { 'file' }
    $sizeBytes = if ($isDirectory) { 0 } else { [int64]$Item.Length }

    $items.Add([pscustomobject]@{
        path = $relativePath
        type = $type
        sizeBytes = $sizeBytes
        lastWriteTimeUtc = $Item.LastWriteTimeUtc.ToString('o')
    }) | Out-Null
}

Add-InventoryItem -Item ([System.IO.DirectoryInfo]$scriptDir)

Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $scriptDir -Force -Recurse -File -Directory | ForEach-Object {
    Add-InventoryItem -Item $_
}

$items | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 3
